top_signals.title: US Keeps Debt-Sale Guidance Steady, Deepening Bill Reliance
top_signals.summary: The US Treasury on Wednesday retained its previous guidance for future debt issuance, signaling no change in note and bond auction sizes well into 2027 even as federal borrowing needs climb.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Africa’s Highest Yielder Tops Debt Returns as Investors Turn Bullish
top_signals.summary: Gabon has become a top performer in emerging sovereign bond markets, buoyed by expectations that an International Monetary Fund program will help it avert a debt restructuring.
